confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors rest on a few sources that are partly dated (Expatistan figures from 2024, Time Out listings undated or from 2023) plus general knowledge. Accommodation sources conflict widely: aggregator averages of about US$35 to 40 for 3-star, and sample December listings of about US$59 to 68. Wine by the glass has no direct price found, so wine_glass is set at about 2x the beer anchor. Cocktail is set from one dated Expatistan estimate. The FX observation is taken from a search summary that cites the RBA exchange rates overview page; the page itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. The anchors are Penang-specific, cross-checked against Malaysian pricing and general Southeast Asian budget-destination levels.
